name: actual-budget-mcp
description: Ask your Actual Budget where the money went, and let it write back safely.
long_description:
Connects Claude to your self-hosted Actual Budget so you can ask questions in plain language: where the money went last month, whether you will make it to payday, which categories drift every month.

It also writes, and it is careful about it. Every delete previews what it would destroy and asks before doing anything, and the ones that find their target by name make you type the name back, because that is where deleting the wrong thing actually happens. There is a read-only mode that hides every write tool from the model entirely, rather than trusting it to refuse.

Your budget data never leaves your machine: the server talks directly to your own Actual server and nothing is sent anywhere else.

server_url.title: Actual server URL
server_url.description: Where your Actual Budget server is reachable, for example http://localhost:5006

sync_id.title: Budget Sync ID
sync_id.description: In Actual, open Settings and click 'Show advanced settings'. Copy the Sync ID, not the Budget ID shown above it: the two look alike and only the Sync ID works here.

password.title: Server password
password.description: The password for your Actual server. Leave empty if your server signs you in through OIDC and you fill in the session token instead.

session_token.title: Session token (OIDC servers only)
session_token.description: Only for servers behind OIDC, which have no password. Find it in your browser's developer tools under IndexedDB, database 'actual', store 'asyncStorage', key 'user-token'. If both this and the password are filled in, the token wins.

encryption_password.title: Encryption password
encryption_password.description: Only needed if your budget file is end-to-end encrypted.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Set to 1 to expose only the reading and analysis tools. The write tools are not registered at all, so Claude never sees them. Leave empty for normal use.
